note: Files outside target_root (platform-ui, ClaudeConsole, nginx, Makefile, test compose) are owned by this sprint; paths are repo-root relative. 01_System/secrets.env is human-edited only and intentionally not listed.

files.role: Dependencies: fastapi>=0.115, uvicorn[standard]>=0.32, pydantic>=2.0, httpx>=0.27; test extras pytest (mirror how ClaudeConsole/StorageTracker make pytest available in their image).

python:3.12-slim + apt ffmpeg (no recommends, clean apt lists); copy 02_Platform/packages to /platform_packages with PYTHONPATH, pip install -e ., copy app/ and config/; CMD uvicorn app.main:app on 0.0.0.0:8000. Build context is repo root.

Service speech, container_name atlas-speech, restart unless-stopped, ports 127.0.0.1:8070:8000 (never 0.0.0.0), network atlas-net external, environment WhisperKey and SPEECH_API_TOKEN passed through from the --env-file values, SPEECH_MODEL / SPEECH_FALLBACK_MODEL / limit variables with the SpeechSettings defaults via ${VAR:-default}, tmpfs mount at SpeechSettings.tmp_dir with a size cap, no volumes, no Postgres variables.

App-local guidance: purpose, audio leaves Atlas to OpenAI, secrets (WhisperKey, SPEECH_API_TOKEN) and where they live, limits, port 8070/9070, run/rebuild commands (make speech-*; rebuild shell image after nginx.conf change), live-API verification results, fallback-model deprecation date.

Default vocabulary: object with prompt (string), keywords (list of strings), languages (list of ISO 639-1 codes). Seed: empty prompt, empty keywords, languages ["en"]. Application-specific vocabulary is passed per request by the consumer, never added here.

Manual checklist (not tooling). Sections: (1) setup: reference script of ~60-90 s containing numbers, proper nouns, product/tool names, a deliberate pause and a long sentence spanning a 15 s chunk boundary; (2) run matrix: desktop Chrome, Android Chrome over HTTPS, with and without pause/resume, with and without per-request keywords; (3) record per run: word error estimate by eye, count of vocabulary terms correct out of total, words lost or duplicated at each chunk boundary, response metrics (audio_duration_ms vs client_duration_ms delta, stop_to_transcript_ms, chunk_count); (4) pass criteria echoing the draft acceptance criteria (duration delta small, no boundary loss, typed text preserved); (5) results table template.

public_objects.name: SpeechSettings
fields: whisper_key: str  (env WhisperKey, default empty; repr/str masked)

files.role: Speech-token gate used as a router dependency.

methods.name: require_speech_token
methods.purpose: Raise SpeechError SPEECH_NOT_CONFIGURED when api_token empty; UNAUTHORIZED when header X-Atlas-Speech-Token mismatches (hmac.compare_digest). Never logs the header.

files.role: Ephemeral recording registry and chunk files under tmp_dir. Single owner of recording lifecycle and deletion.

methods.name: __init__
methods.purpose: Create tmp_dir and remove anything left in it (startup sweep).

methods.name: create
methods.purpose: Enforce allowlist and active cap, allocate id and directory.

methods.name: get
methods.purpose: Return state or raise RECORDING_NOT_FOUND.

methods.name: write_chunk
methods.purpose: Implements receive_chunk rules incl. caps, idempotency, conflict, total-cap deletion, receive-time accounting.

methods.name: begin_finalize
methods.purpose: open->finalizing under a per-recording lock; duration pre-check; return ordered chunk paths or raise MISSING_CHUNKS (status restored to open) / RECORDING_BUSY / RECORDING_TOO_LONG (deleted).

methods.name: end_finalize
methods.purpose: retain=True restores status open and touches last_activity (upstream failure); retain=False deletes files and state. Always deletes when cancelled flag set.

methods.name: cancel
methods.purpose: Idempotent discard; if finalizing only sets cancelled.

methods.name: delete
methods.purpose: Remove directory and state unconditionally.

methods.name: reap_idle
methods.purpose: Delete recordings idle beyond idle_ttl_s; return count. Called by the periodic task in main.py.

methods.name: get_store
methods.purpose: Process-wide singleton accessor; FastAPI dependency.

files.role: Concatenation and ffmpeg interaction.

methods.name: assemble
methods.purpose: Byte-concatenate in given order, remux with ffmpeg -c copy, measure decoded duration (decode to null muxer; do not trust container header), raise INVALID_AUDIO on failure/zero duration or RECORDING_TOO_LONG above max_duration_s. Subprocess is time-limited by ffmpeg_timeout_s and never shell-interpolated.

files.role: Default vocabulary loading, per-field override resolution, model-specific parameter mapping.

methods.name: load_defaults
methods.purpose: Read vocabulary.json; missing file or fields yield empty values, languages default ["en"].

methods.name: resolve
methods.purpose: Per field: None keeps default, empty clears, value replaces.

methods.name: to_form_fields
methods.purpose: model gpt-transcribe: native prompt, keywords, languages fields (encoding verified live, see architecture open_questions). Any other model: keywords folded into prompt text, prompt truncated to a conservative length for the 224-token limit, single language hint only when exactly one language is given.

files.role: Headless recorder state machine (internal_flow step 12). Never throws; failures surface through state and error.

methods.name: useRecorder
methods.returns: { state: RecorderState; elapsedMs: number; error: string | null; supported: boolean; unsupportedReason: string | null; start(): Promise<void>; pause(): void; resume(): void; stop(): Promise<void>; cancel(): void; retry(): Promise<void> }
methods.purpose: start: secure-context and MediaRecorder check, pick supported mime from the backend allowlist, getUserMedia, create recording, MediaRecorder.start(timeslice from limits) once. stop: recorder.stop, drain upload queue (sequential, 3 attempts with backoff per chunk), POST stop, deliver result with ClientMetrics, release tracks, clear buffers. retry: re-run upload-missing + stop from buffered chunks after needs_token or a retained-upstream-failure error. cancel: from any active state, release mic, abort in-flight, DELETE, clear buffers. Unmount cancels. Auto-stop at limits.max_duration_s. onBusyChange(true) while state is not idle/error/needs_token.
